name: status: idea

name: status: discussion
description: Feedback or a decision is needed.

name: status: research
description: Evidence question selected; findings may still be pending.

name: status: proposed
description: Defined scope is ready for a decision.

name: status: approved
description: Exact scope accepted with a recorded decision.

name: status: development
description: Approved work has an accepting contributor and work record.

name: status: released
description: Accepted output published with evidence and limitations.

name: status: deferred
description: Paused with a reason and reconsideration condition.

description: Metric definitions, dashboards and data analysis.

description: Solana observations or separately reviewed experiments.

name: type: security
description: Security policy, review or reporting process.

name: type: branding
description: Art, memes, media, UX and brand proposals.
